reasoning: Six explicit user-visible capabilities named in the body — one feature each.

children.title: OAuth2 login flow
children.body:
Users can sign in using a configured OAuth2 provider.

**Acceptance:**
- Provider list configurable per environment
- Successful auth establishes a session
- Failures surface a clear error

children.title: Password-based login
children.body:
Users with local accounts can sign in by email + password.

**Acceptance:**
- Password compared with constant-time hash verification
- Rate-limited per identity
- Lockout after N failures

children.title: MFA enrollment and challenge
children.body:
Users can enroll TOTP, and the second factor is required on each session.

**Acceptance:**
- TOTP enroll flow
- Challenge on login
- Backup-code recovery

children.title: Password reset
children.body:
Users can reset a forgotten password via a one-time email link.

**Acceptance:**
- Token expires in 30 min
- One-time use
- Audit-logged

children.title: Session management
children.body:
Sessions are revocable, with explicit listing per user.

**Acceptance:**
- User can list active sessions
- User can revoke any session
- Admin can revoke another user's session

children.title: Admin user impersonation
children.body:
Authorized admins can impersonate a user with full audit trail.

**Acceptance:**
- Impersonation only with explicit admin grant
- All impersonated actions audit-logged
- Banner visible to admin during impersonation
